crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Oval-shaped reddish-brown patch on the posterior crown and nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp linear color transition between the reddish-brown crown and grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly contrastive white spots forming transverse rows on the dark tail feathers.
